content.text: The logs clearly show the failure signature: at 16:06:00Z the error type shifts from occasional `ClientDisconnected` (background noise) to `PaymentProviderFailed: api.io-pay.example returned 503`, which then dominates and drives error rate to 100%. Latency also jumps sharply at the same time (p50 44ms→156ms→2044ms), consistent with the service blocking/timing out on calls to the downstream payment provider. No deploys or config changes were recorded in the preceding week, ruling out bad-deployment/config/flag causes.

hypotheses.subject: api.io-pay.example
hypotheses.summary: The payment provider dependency (api.io-pay.example) began returning 503 errors, and io-shop's account page requests that call it for card data failed outright, driving error rate to 100% and latency to spike (p50 44ms -> 2044ms) as calls waited on/failed against the unhealthy upstream.
